Definition: of Hebrew origin (H6147); Er, an Israelite:--Er.
BiblicalUsage: The word Ḗr covers Er, an Israelite. It occurs just once, in Luke.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Ḗr as it stands — Er, an Israelite — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
